title: Cross-sectional Spot-hedged USD-M funding carry
hypothesis: Persistently positive settled funding across liquid common Binance Spot and USD-M symbols can pay for an equal-base long-Spot short-perpetual basket after paired execution costs.

distinctness.S-1D: No naked perpetual long/short dispersion. Every selected symbol is long Spot and short the same USD-M perpetual in equal base quantity; there is no low-funding long-perpetual tail.
distinctness.S-1G: Multi-symbol cross-sectional funding ranking only; no BTC-only basis threshold, basis forecast, or convergence exit.
distinctness.S-1H: No BTC/ETH relative-basis residual, z-score, or basis-dislocation signal.
distinctness.S-1I: Funding is the only ranking signal; there is no Premium Index signal and no futures-only mean-reversion basket.

calendar.holdoutClaim: July 2025-June 2026 outcome archive members are evaluator-unopened until the S-1J holdout marker; June 2025 embargo/warmup rows are preloaded before candidate seal. The public data are not globally unpublished.

universe.screenRule: Exact-name symbols with checksum-verified June 2024 Spot 1d, USD-M regular 1h, USD-M mark-price 1h, and funding-rate archives in the two frozen parent manifests.
universe.custodyQuarantineReason: Three BTCUSDT archive members were sampled for schema-only preflight before freeze; BTCUSDT is excluded from every S-1J cohort and outcome.
universe.liquidityScore: Minimum of previous complete UTC-day and trailing-seven-complete-day median quote volume on both Spot and USD-M, observed strictly before entry.
universe.missingness: A symbol missing causal inputs is ineligible. A missing selected future entry, exit, mark, or funding leg invalidates the whole scheduled week; no replacement or resizing.

signal.onlyInput: settled funding rates with timestamps strictly before entry
signal.eligibility: At least two settlements, complete interval-aware window coverage, strictly positive score, and latest settled funding rate strictly positive.

trials.selection: Highest minimum STRESS Bonferroni LCB across 4-week and 8-week bootstraps; then higher exact STRESS development net; then lexical trialId.

portfolio.baseNeutrality: qSpot + qPerpetual = 0 exactly per selected symbol
portfolio.allocation: For each declared slot, base quantity is slot budget divided by max(Spot open, USD-M open), so neither leg exceeds its unlevered budget. Residual and unused-slot capital stays cash. Perpetual base quantity exactly equals Spot base quantity.
portfolio.fundingWindow: Funding settlement hours strictly inside (entry, exit), conservatively excluding entry and exit hours including archive +1ms stamps. Actual interval fields must cover the window without a gap. Event mark uses same-hour USD-M mark-price open proxy.
portfolio.entryExitPrice: Spot daily open and USD-M regular 1h open at Monday 00:00 UTC.
portfolio.drawdownProxy: Daily 00:00 UTC marked equity using Spot daily open, USD-M mark-price 1h open, accrued funding, and complete costs.

execution.pairedAtomicity: Both legs or neither; no one-leg state is retained.

makerEntry.model: Hypothetical paired post-only entry priced at archive open; no claim that either order filled.

execution.decisionExecution: Immediate paired taker entry and exit at the declared archive-open proxy, independent of the non-authoritative maker sensitivity; daily Spot data cannot identify a later fallback price.

statistics.matrix: Synchronous 51 by 12 weekly net USD per $1k for each decision scenario; valid no-signal weeks are exact zero and remain in all denominators.
statistics.rawP: One-sided null-centered joint circular block bootstrap with plus-one correction.
statistics.multiplicity: Holm step-down over all 12 declared trials plus synchronous White max-mean reality check, separately for PROXY and STRESS.
statistics.simultaneousLcb: One-sided Bonferroni 95% family LCB for every trial at both 4-week and 8-week blocks.

pbo.method: CSCV on first 48 development weeks as 12 contiguous four-week blocks; all choose(12,6)=924 splits; STRESS sums; equality to the OOS median counts as overfit.

statistics.holdoutIntervals: Champion-only 4-week and 8-week circular-block two-sided 95% intervals and one-sided 95% LCBs.

capacity.volumeBasis: Weakest of Spot and USD-M previous-day and trailing-seven-day median quote volume at both entry and exit.

verdictLaw.UNMEASURED: Invalid custody, chronology, schema, selected-leg completeness, matrix, reconciliation, or inference yields null economics. If every public proxy gate passes, the capital verdict still remains UNMEASURED because account-effective fees and executable paired fill/depth capacity are UNKNOWN.
verdictLaw.NO_GO: Valid measurable public data with any development or opened-holdout net, interval, multiplicity, sample, stress, drawdown, or volume-capacity gate failure.
verdictLaw.GO: Structurally unreachable in this public-only lane; it additionally requires fresh account-effective fee proof and executable paired fill/depth proof.
verdictLaw.crossFamilyMultiplicity: S-META1 does not preauthorize S-1J; N3 successor must treat cross-family p as 1 until a prospectively frozen registry successor exists.
